wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# Pé na Areia - Sustainable Delivery App for Santos Beachfront

## Project Introduction

**Pé na Areia** is a sustainable delivery application designed specifically for the beachfront of Santos, Brazil. The app addresses the unique challenge of delivering food and goods to beachgoers who don't have formal addresses but instead use geolocation pins and official reference points along the coastline.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- Enable sustainable delivery services on Santos beachfront using geolocation-based ordering
- Provide an intuitive interface for selecting delivery locations via draggable map pins
- Integrate with official beach reference points (postos de salvamento) for precise location identification
- Support eco-friendly packaging options and environmentally conscious delivery practices

### Target Audience
- Beach visitors and tourists in Santos seeking convenient food delivery
- Local kiosks and restaurants partnering with the delivery service
- Delivery couriers operating in the beachfront area
- Environmentally conscious consumers preferring sustainable delivery options

## Technical Architecture

The project follows a modern microservices-inspired architecture with clear separation between frontend and backend concerns:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Flutter Mobile App] --> B[REST API Layer]
    B --> C[Business Logic Services]
    C --> D[MongoDB Database]
    
    E[Reference Points] --> D
    F[Kiosks/Restaurants] --> D
    G[Orders & Deliveries] --> D
    
    H[Google Maps Integration] --> A
    I[Geolocation Services] --> A
```

### Component Breakdown

**Backend (Spring Boot + MongoDB)**
- RESTful API endpoints for order management and reference point queries
- Geospatial indexing for proximity searches and location-based features
- JWT security framework ready for authentication implementation
- Seed data initialization for official beach reference points

**Frontend (Flutter)**
- Cross-platform mobile application supporting Android and iOS
- Interactive map interface with draggable location pins
- Provider-based state management for reactive UI updates
- Google Maps integration for real-time location services

### Design Patterns
- **Repository Pattern**: Data access abstraction through Spring Data repositories
- **Service Layer Pattern**: Business logic encapsulation in dedicated service classes
- **DTO Pattern**: Clean data transfer objects for API communication
- **Provider Pattern**: State management in Flutter frontend

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Backend Application**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/PeNaAreiaApplication.java` - Spring Boot application entry point
- `backend/src/main/resources/application.yml` - Configuration for MongoDB, JWT, and application settings

**Frontend Application**
- `frontend/lib/main.dart` - Flutter app bootstrap and theme configuration

### Core Modules

**Order Management System**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/model/Order.java` - Comprehensive order model with geospatial pin support
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/controller/OrderController.java` - REST endpoints for order creation and retrieval
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/service/OrderService.java` - Business logic for order processing

**Reference Point System**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/model/ReferencePoint.java` - Official beach reference point model
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/controller/ReferencePointController.java` - Endpoints for reference point queries and proximity search

**Kiosk Management**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/model/Kiosk.java` - Restaurant/kiosk entity model
- `backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/controller/KioskController.java` - Kiosk listing and management endpoints

### Configuration Approach

**Environment-Based Configuration**
- MongoDB connection strings via environment variables (`MONGODB_URI`, `MONGODB_DATABASE`)
- JWT secret management through secure environment variables
- Google Maps API key configuration for both Android and iOS platforms

**Database Schema**
- MongoDB collections with geospatial indexing for location-based queries
- Automatic index creation for performance optimization
- Seed data initialization for official beach reference points

### External Dependencies

**Backend Dependencies**
- Spring Boot 3.3.4 with MongoDB integration
- JWT authentication framework (jjwt 0.12.6)
- Swagger/OpenAPI documentation (springdoc-openapi 2.6.0)
- Lombok for boilerplate reduction

**Frontend Dependencies**
- Google Maps Flutter plugin for interactive maps
- Geolocator for device GPS functionality
- Provider for state management
- Firebase integration for push notifications

### Integration Points

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as Mobile User
    participant FlutterApp as Flutter App
    participant API as Backend API
    participant MongoDB as MongoDB Database
    
    User->>FlutterApp: Select location on map
    FlutterApp->>API: GET /reference-points/nearby
    API->>MongoDB: Query nearby reference points
    MongoDB-->>API: Return reference points
    API-->>FlutterApp: JSON response
    FlutterApp-->>User: Display nearby points
    
    User->>FlutterApp: Create order with pin
    FlutterApp->>API: POST /orders
    API->>MongoDB: Store order with geospatial data
    MongoDB-->>API: Confirmation
    API-->>FlutterApp: Order confirmation
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Location Selection Interface**
- Interactive map with draggable pins for precise location selection
- Automatic suggestions of nearby official reference points
- Location description and optional photo attachment capabilities
- Real-time geolocation services integration

**Order Management System**
- Complete order lifecycle from creation to delivery tracking
- Geospatial order storage with location locking after payment
- Status timeline tracking for delivery progress monitoring
- Support for sustainable packaging preferences

**Reference Point System**
- Official beach reference point database with geospatial indexing
- Proximity-based reference point suggestions
- Static seed data for Santos beachfront reference points
- Active/inactive status management for reference points

### Implementation Highlights

**Geospatial Capabilities**
- MongoDB 2DSPHERE indexing for efficient location queries
- GeoJSON coordinate format standardization across the application
- Radius-based proximity searches for reference points and delivery validation
- Location pin locking mechanism to prevent post-payment modifications

**Mobile Experience**
- Material Design 3 theming with custom color scheme
- Responsive UI components optimized for mobile devices
- Offline-capable location selection with online synchronization
- Push notification support for delivery status updates

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> LocationSelection
    LocationSelection --> OrderCreation: Pin Selected
    OrderCreation --> PaymentProcessing: Order Submitted
    PaymentProcessing --> OrderConfirmed: Payment Success
    PaymentProcessing --> OrderCancelled: Payment Failed
    OrderConfirmed --> DeliveryTracking: Courier Assigned
    DeliveryTracking --> DeliveryComplete: Location Verified
    DeliveryComplete --> [*]
    
    LocationSelection --> ReferencePointSuggestion: Nearby Points
    ReferencePointSuggestion --> LocationSelection: Point Selected
```

## Conclusion and Recommendations

### Project Architecture Summary

Pé na Areia demonstrates a well-structured approach to solving the unique challenges of beachfront delivery logistics. The separation of concerns between the Flutter frontend and Spring Boot backend provides clear boundaries and maintainability. The geospatial-first design philosophy ensures that location accuracy remains central to the user experience.

### Architectural Strengths

- **Geospatial Focus**: MongoDB's native geospatial capabilities provide robust location-based functionality
- **Clean Separation**: Clear distinction between presentation, business logic, and data layers
- **Scalable Foundation**: Ready for authentication, payment processing, and real-time features
- **Mobile-First Design**: Flutter enables cross-platform deployment with consistent user experience

### Potential Improvement Areas

- **Authentication Implementation**: Complete JWT security filter integration as marked in SecurityConfig
- **Payment Processing**: Implement payment gateway integration with location locking mechanism
- **Real-time Tracking**: Add WebSocket or polling mechanisms for live courier tracking
- **Image Storage**: Implement Firebase Storage integration for location photos
- **Testing Coverage**: Add comprehensive unit tests for critical endpoints and business logic

### Actionable Recommendations

1. **Implement Authentication**: Complete the JWT security filter implementation in `SecurityConfig.java`
2. **Add Payment Integration**: Connect with a payment processor and implement the location locking feature
3. **Enhance Testing**: Develop unit tests for order creation, reference point queries, and geospatial operations
4. **Optimize Performance**: Consider caching strategies for frequently accessed reference points and kiosk data
5. **Monitor Deployment**: Set up proper logging and monitoring for production environments

### Next Steps for Project Evolution

- Complete the remaining frontend screens for checkout, delivery tracking, and courier identification
- Implement the delivery driver app with route optimization and delivery confirmation
- Add real-time communication features using WebSockets for live order tracking
- Expand the reference point system to support additional beachfront areas
- Implement analytics and reporting features for business insights

Sources:
- [README.md](README.md)
- [pom.xml](backend/pom.xml)
- [pubspec.yaml](frontend/pubspec.yaml)
- [PeNaAreiaApplication.java](backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/PeNaAreiaApplication.java)
- [application.yml](backend/src/main/resources/application.yml)
- [Order.java](backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/model/Order.java)
- [ReferencePoint.java](backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/model/ReferencePoint.java)
- [OrderController.java](backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/controller/OrderController.java)
- [ReferencePointController.java](backend/src/main/java/com/penaareia/controller/ReferencePointController.java)
- [main.dart](frontend/lib/main.dart)

</blog>
